messages:
incident-bot: PAGED SRE-NET (SEV2) — cross-region routing anomaly: large p50 latency spike and elevated 502s for eu-west. Pager: https://pd.example/INC-9284

oncall-net: ack — investigating egress health for eu-west clusters, grabbing logs now.

sre-alex: I can see repeated NIC flaps on egress node eu-west-1a (host-52.10.23.7) -> BGP withdraws, route policy falls back to us-west. That explains cross-region shift + latency.

eng-runtime-jin: rolling out note — we pushed a route-policy change at 07:12 UTC (policy id 0x7f) that tightened pinning heuristics. Could be interacting poorly with transient egress withdraws.

support-elaine: multiple customer reports: T-1234, T-2468, T-5577 seeing timeouts/502s starting ~07:15. Raising impact to product.

oncall-net: immediate mitigation options: (A) revert 0x7f, (B) manually pin VIPs for affected tenants to eu-west. Which is faster?

sre-alex: manual pin is fastest for top customers; revert safer for global correctness. I'll prepare control-plane commands for manual pin.

eng-runtime-jin: starting rollback for policy 0x7f to canary, then global if canary green. Command: `./infractl policy rollback --id 0x7f --mode canary`

incident-bot: deploy job queued: deploy-1743 (rollback 0x7f) — watch logs at https://ci.example/builds/1743

oncall-net: manual pinning applied for VIPs: vip-eu-01 (10.200.1.0/24) and vip-eu-02 (10.200.2.0/24) -> forced-eu-west route. Initial telemetry: pinned VIP flows show drop in 502s :white_check_mark:

sre-alex: non-pinned traffic still shows elevated latency — sounds like DNS + cache TTLs still directing some clients to fallback region after withdraws. TTLs are 30s but some resolvers caching longer.

eng-runtime-jin: can confirm rollback to canary started. If canary is stable in 10m we'll promote. Also opened PR 2456 to add guard in pin-eval logic for egress withdraws to avoid flip-flopping.

support-elaine: Customer comms sent for affected tenants: initial status + mitigation steps + ETA ~1h for full resolution.

product-maya: marking this for postmortem. Owner: eng-runtime (jin). Please capture timeline, config diff, and customer impact matrix.

oncall-net: rollback canary succeeded and promoted to global at 07:34 UTC. Observed gradual normalization of region affinity metrics.

sre-alex: monitoring: 502 rate down 85% for pinned VIPs, overall error rate down 60%. Still watching latency tail for non-pinned flows.

oncall-net: leaving handoff note for morning: manual pins still present for VIPs, rollback complete, PR 2456 in review to harden pin eval. Handoff to @sre-lee in 30m.

sre-lee: ack handoff — will monitor dashboards and check for any re-flares.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — partial mitigation in place, customers affected reduced. Severity: Sev2 -> mitigated (monitoring).

support-elaine: will follow up with full RCA draft after postmortem.

product-maya: thanks team — schedule postmortem 24h window and include runbook updates for similar egress flaps.

incident-bot: incident thread closed for active paging; keep channel for updates.
